title: 2020 Census ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (ZCTA5), 2026
description: The 'ZIP Code Tabulation Area 5 Digit 20' layer of the 2026 TIGER/Line Nation-Level Geography National GeoPackage: 33,791 rows. Columns and values unchanged; 2D geometry in NAD83 (EPSG:4269) with a bbox covering, Hilbert-sorted, as one GeoParquet 2.0 file read in place over HTTPS or the anonymous S3 endpoint s3.geomermaids.com, and a PMTiles archive for web maps. The Census Bureau makes no warranty on the accuracy of TIGER/Line, and its boundaries are for statistical data collection and tabulation only: not a determination of jurisdictional authority, ownership or entitlement, and not legal land descriptions. Credit: U.S. Census Bureau, TIGER/Line 2026.

table:columns.name: ZCTA5CE20
table:columns.description: 2020 Census. 5-digit ZIP Code Tabulation Area code.

table:columns.name: GEOID20
table:columns.description: 2020 Census. Area identifier: the codes of the areas it nests in, then its own code (e.g. state + county + tract for a tract).

table:columns.name: GEOIDFQ20
table:columns.description: 2020 Census. Fully qualified GEOID, used to join data tables from data.census.gov.

table:columns.name: MTFCC20
table:columns.description: 2020 Census. MAF/TIGER feature class code, the kind of area (e.g. G5200 congressional district, G4020 county, G5020 census tract).

table:columns.name: INTPTLAT20
table:columns.description: 2020 Census. Latitude of the internal point (text, as published).

table:columns.name: INTPTLON20
table:columns.description: 2020 Census. Longitude of the internal point (text, as published).

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Area outline as native Parquet GEOMETRY (WKB), NAD83 (EPSG:4269), longitude and latitude, 2D.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin FLOAT, ymin FLOAT, xmax FLOAT, ymax FLOAT)
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), declared as the GeoParquet covering. Filter on it to prune row groups.
